M01X_RADIO_01.speaker: RADIO
M01X_RADIO_01.text: Six forty-seven in Nexus City. Clear skies over the harbor, light traffic on the Spire Loop.

M01X_RADIO_02.speaker: RADIO
M01X_RADIO_02.text: And the Capitol says the stability towers finish their maintenance cycle by noon. Stay with us.

M01X_PHONE_MOM.speaker: MOM
M01X_PHONE_MOM.text: Call me when you're up. Love you.

M01X_PHONE_MARA.speaker: MARA
M01X_PHONE_MARA.text: Morning, neighbor! Coffee in the Sky Lounge later? Eleventh floor. Don't be late.

M01X_PHONE_ALERT.speaker: NEXUS ALERT
M01X_PHONE_ALERT.text: Grid maintenance near the stability towers today. Expect flickers.

CINE_00.speaker: NEWS
CINE_00.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Authorities are investigating unusual atmospheric disturbances reported overnight.

CINE_02.speaker: NEWS
CINE_02.text: We're receiving reports of an unidentified phenomenon above the central district—

CINE_06.speaker: NOVA
CINE_06.text: My designation is NOVA. There isn't time to explain.

CINE_08.speaker: NOVA
CINE_08.text: Your reality is collapsing. You need to move. Now.

CINE_09.speaker: NOVA
CINE_09.text: And whatever you do, don't touch the fractures.

M01X_ALARM_PA.speaker: BUILDING
M01X_ALARM_PA.text: Emergency. Structural event. Elevators offline. Use the emergency stairs.

M01X_ALARM_MARA.speaker: MARA
M01X_ALARM_MARA.text: Is anyone there? I'm stuck in the Sky Lounge on eleven. The doors jammed. Please!

M01X_SHOUT_1.speaker: RESIDENT
M01X_SHOUT_1.text: Get out! Get out of the building!

M01X_SHOUT_2.speaker: RESIDENT
M01X_SHOUT_2.text: Where are the stairs? I can't see anything!

M01X_RESCUE.speaker: MARA
M01X_RESCUE.text: You came back for me. Go, go. I'm right behind you.

M01X_DAZED.speaker: MARA
M01X_DAZED.text: Something's coming out of the smoke. Move!

M01X_SURGE_1.speaker: NOVA
M01X_SURGE_1.text: Your body just answered the Fracture. Armor forming. Weapon system online.

M01X_SURGE_2.speaker: NOVA
M01X_SURGE_2.text: Point it at them and squeeze. Your hands know how.

M01X_ANCHOR_1.speaker: NOVA
M01X_ANCHOR_1.text: Something big is anchoring itself to the tear. Your resonance is spiking.

M01X_ANCHOR_2.speaker: NOVA
M01X_ANCHOR_2.text: Don't hold it back. Let it out.

M01X_CLEAR_2.speaker: MARA
M01X_CLEAR_2.text: What did they do to you? What are you?

M01X_CLEAR_3.speaker: NOVA
M01X_CLEAR_3.text: I don't know yet either. Stay with me. We'll learn the rest as we go.

M01X_NUDGE_SURGE.speaker: NOVA
M01X_NUDGE_SURGE.text: Breathe. Find one in your sights. Squeeze.

M01X_NUDGE_ANCHOR.speaker: NOVA
M01X_NUDGE_ANCHOR.text: Reach for it. The surge in your chest: release it at the anchor.

M01X_WORLD_1.speaker: NOVA
M01X_WORLD_1.text: Every city on this world woke up somewhere new this morning.

M01X_WORLD_2.speaker: NOVA
M01X_WORLD_2.text: Nexus was only the first to notice.

M01X_WORLD_3.speaker: PLAYER
M01X_WORLD_3.text: Then we'd better find out where we are.

M01_001.speaker: NEWS
M01_001.text: Good morning, Nexus City. Overnight, residents reported unusual lights over the harbor.

M01_002.speaker: PLAYER
M01_002.text: Another ordinary morning. That would be nice.

M01_003.speaker: NEWS
M01_003.text: Officials say there is no cause for alarm—

M01_005.speaker: NOVA
M01_005.text: Neural resonance confirmed. Can you hear me?

M01_007.speaker: NOVA
M01_007.text: NOVA. Your building is destabilizing. Leave the apartment now.

M01_009.speaker: NOVA
M01_009.text: A Fracture. Reality is intersecting with something it was never meant to touch.

M01_010.speaker: PLAYER
M01_010.text: There are people trapped in the hall.

M01_011.speaker: NOVA
M01_011.text: Then we help them. Move. I will guide you.

M01_013.speaker: PLAYER
M01_013.text: Get behind me. I think I can move this.

M01_014.speaker: NOVA
M01_014.text: That energy came from you. We will understand it later.

M01_015.speaker: PLAYER
M01_015.text: Later sounds good. Where is the exit?

M02_001.speaker: CIVILIAN
M02_001.text: My daughter is on the other side of that door!

M02_002.speaker: PLAYER
M02_002.text: Stay low. I am getting her out.

M02_003.speaker: NOVA
M02_003.text: Structural failure in twenty seconds. The support beam is shifting.

M02_004.speaker: PLAYER
M02_004.text: I can feel something in my hands.

M02_005.speaker: NOVA
M02_005.text: Focus on the beam. Do not fight the current; redirect it.

M02_008.speaker: CIVILIAN
M02_008.text: Thank you. I thought we were gone.

M02_009.speaker: PLAYER
M02_009.text: Take the service stairs. Do not stop.

M02_010.speaker: NOVA
M02_010.text: You used a Fracture ability without an Operator interface. That should be impossible.

M02_011.speaker: PLAYER
M02_011.text: Then stop telling me what should be possible.

M03_001.speaker: RADIO
M03_001.text: Emergency services are asking residents to shelter indoors.

M03_002.speaker: PLAYER
M03_002.text: That advice is a little late.

M03_003.speaker: NOVA
M03_003.text: Three safe routes. Two are already changing.

M03_005.speaker: NOVA
M03_005.text: The road ahead now connects to a place that did not exist this morning.

M03_006.speaker: SURVIVOR
M03_006.text: Those things came out of the purple light!

M03_007.speaker: PLAYER
M03_007.text: Get to the transit station. I will hold them off.

M03_008.speaker: NOVA
M03_008.text: Remember: cover, movement, then ability. Survive first.

M03_009.speaker: PLAYER
M03_009.text: And if the street tears open again?

M04_002.speaker: PLAYER
M04_002.text: I woke up in an apartment. Is that an affiliation?

M04_003.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_003.text: Not if you can explain how you survived the breach.

M04_005.speaker: PLAYER
M04_005.text: I can hear a voice. It says its name is NOVA.

M04_006.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_006.text: That is not possible. NOVA was decommissioned.

M04_007.speaker: NOVA
M04_007.text: That is an inaccurate description of events.

M04_008.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_008.text: Come with us. We can keep civilians safe.

M04_009.speaker: PLAYER
M04_009.text: I will come. But I decide who I help.

M05_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_001.text: We need people who can withstand the Fractures.

M05_002.speaker: PLAYER
M05_002.text: You need soldiers. I am not one.

M05_003.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_003.text: Then be something better. Make your own choice.

M05_004.speaker: NOVA
M05_004.text: There are benefits to cooperating. There are also risks.

M05_005.speaker: PLAYER
M05_005.text: I am not signing away my life because the sky cracked.

M05_006.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_006.text: Fair. Prove you can protect this district, and we talk again.

M05_cooperate_001.speaker: PLAYER
M05_cooperate_001.text: I will work with your team, but civilians come first.

M05_cooperate_002.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_cooperate_002.text: Agreed. You answer to your conscience before you answer to me.

M05_independent_001.speaker: PLAYER
M05_independent_001.text: I will help, but I am not joining your command.

M05_independent_002.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_independent_002.text: Then prove that independence is not indifference.

M06_001.speaker: NOVA
M06_001.text: Verdant Forest. The vegetation has absorbed Fracture energy.

M06_003.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_003.text: That is how it catches you off guard.

M06_004.speaker: PLAYER
M06_004.text: You have been out here alone?

M06_005.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_005.text: Long enough to learn that the forest remembers footsteps.

M06_007.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_007.text: Do not call every secret a target. Some deserve to stay hidden.

M06_008.speaker: PLAYER
M06_008.text: We will look. We will not destroy what we do not understand.

M07_001.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_001.text: Outsiders keep taking samples. Then they wonder why the trees attack.

M07_002.speaker: PLAYER
M07_002.text: I came for answers, not trophies.

M07_004.speaker: NOVA
M07_004.text: The dungeon architecture is shifting while we speak.

M07_005.speaker: PLAYER
M07_005.text: Then our map is already wrong.

M07_006.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_006.text: Follow the living roots. They do not lie. They simply refuse to explain.

M07_protect_forest_001.speaker: PLAYER
M07_protect_forest_001.text: Seal the extraction site. The forest has already paid enough.

M07_protect_forest_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_protect_forest_002.text: Then you have an ally here.

M07_take_sample_001.speaker: PLAYER
M07_take_sample_001.text: One sample, documented, and no more damage.

M07_take_sample_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_take_sample_002.text: I will hold you to every word.

M08_001.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_001.text: Your ride will survive the dunes. Your driving? Different question.

M08_002.speaker: PLAYER
M08_002.text: How much for a vehicle that does not fall apart?

M08_003.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_003.text: More than you have. Win the convoy run and we can negotiate.

M08_004.speaker: NOVA
M08_004.text: Weather front approaching. Sand density rising.

M08_005.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_005.text: Out here the storm is a rival, not a backdrop.

M09_001.speaker: VYRAK
M09_001.text: WHO DISTURBS THE COVENANT OF ASH?

M09_002.speaker: PLAYER
M09_002.text: Someone who has crossed too much desert to turn around.

M09_004.speaker: NOVA
M09_004.text: Airborne phase. Watch the shadow before the dive.

M09_006.speaker: VYRAK
M09_006.text: MY SCALES BREAK, BUT MY OATH DOES NOT.

M09_007.speaker: NOVA
M09_007.text: Chest weak point exposed. Wait for the next attack cycle.

M09_008.speaker: PLAYER
M09_008.text: I am not here to steal your power.

M09_009.speaker: VYRAK
M09_009.text: THEN SHOW ME WHY YOU DESERVE TO LIVE.

M09_010.speaker: NOVA
M09_010.text: Final strike window. Your choice must be deliberate.

M10_001.speaker: PLAYER
M10_001.text: You were the size of a mountain a minute ago.

M10_002.speaker: VYRAK
M10_002.text: DO NOT CONFUSE FORM WITH STRENGTH, LITTLE OPERATOR.

M10_005.speaker: VYRAK
M10_005.text: TRUST IS EARNED. RIDING IS NOT A PRIZE FOR ONE VICTORY.

M10_006.speaker: PLAYER
M10_006.text: Then we start by learning to work together.

M11_001.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_001.text: In Neon City every camera sees you, and every camera can lie.

M11_002.speaker: PLAYER
M11_002.text: I need the source of the Fracture signal.

M11_003.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_003.text: Then you need a driver, a hacker, and a reason not to trust either.

M11_004.speaker: NOVA
M11_004.text: I can perform the second role.

M11_005.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_005.text: Great. The ghost in your head has opinions.

M11_006.speaker: PLAYER
M11_006.text: Can we focus on the signal?

M11_007.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_007.text: Win tonight’s race. I will open the right doors.

M12_001.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_001.text: Thalassia sits offshore from Verdant Forest, deeper than most maps admit.

M12_002.speaker: PLAYER
M12_002.text: How does a whole city survive down there?

M12_004.speaker: NOVA
M12_004.text: Pressure shielding nominal. Unknown life signatures nearby.

M12_005.speaker: PLAYER
M12_005.text: That is a very large shadow.

M12_006.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_006.text: Do not chase it. The sea is not ours to command.

M13_001.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_001.text: Our records show a Fracture before the one you witnessed.

M13_002.speaker: PLAYER
M13_002.text: Why did nobody tell the surface?

M13_004.speaker: NOVA
M13_004.text: Some records are encrypted with my architecture.

M13_007.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_007.text: You may take the archive or protect the people who keep it.

M13_008.speaker: PLAYER
M13_008.text: I am not choosing blind. Tell me what each costs.

M13_preserve_archive_001.speaker: PLAYER
M13_preserve_archive_001.text: The archive stays here. We make copies with your permission.

M13_preserve_archive_002.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_preserve_archive_002.text: For the first time, someone asked.

M13_extract_archive_001.speaker: PLAYER
M13_extract_archive_001.text: We need the archive to prevent another collapse.

M13_extract_archive_002.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_extract_archive_002.text: Then carry the weight of what you have taken.

M14_001.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_001.text: The storm does not kill you quickly. It convinces you to stop moving.

M14_002.speaker: PLAYER
M14_002.text: What is transmitting from the glacier?

M14_003.speaker: NOVA
M14_003.text: A distress call. It is older than the current Fracture.

M14_004.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_004.text: Then whoever sent it should be dead.

M14_005.speaker: PLAYER
M14_005.text: We are going to find out.

M14_006.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_006.text: That answer is why I agreed to guide you.

M15_001.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
M15_001.text: YOU WALK THROUGH A KINGDOM THAT REFUSED TO DIE.

M15_002.speaker: PLAYER
M15_002.text: I did not come to take your throne.

M15_004.speaker: NOVA
M15_004.text: The crown is amplifying the storm. Disable its anchors.

M15_005.speaker: PLAYER
M15_005.text: Then we free the people trapped here.

M15_006.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
M15_006.text: IF YOU BREAK THE CROWN, REMEMBER THOSE IT HELD.

M16_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_001.text: People are calling you a hero. Others are calling you a threat.

M16_003.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_003.text: They know what your choices did to their streets.

M16_004.speaker: NOVA
M16_004.text: Your reputation is changing how factions respond.

M16_005.speaker: PLAYER
M16_005.text: Good. Let them respond to what I do next.

M16_006.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_006.text: Then make sure your next choice is worth defending.

M17_001.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_001.text: Weapons, vehicles, secrets. Everything has a price.

M17_002.speaker: PLAYER
M17_002.text: And what is the price of trust?

M17_003.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_003.text: Usually the thing you cannot afford to lose.

M17_004.speaker: NOVA
M17_004.text: Three factions have offered conflicting contracts.

M17_005.speaker: PLAYER
M17_005.text: Then we choose who benefits, not just who pays.

M17_006.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_006.text: Careful. That kind of thinking is expensive.

M17_support_civilians_001.speaker: PLAYER
M17_support_civilians_001.text: The contract goes to rebuilding the district.

M17_support_civilians_002.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_support_civilians_002.text: You are turning a profit into a promise.

M17_support_faction_001.speaker: PLAYER
M17_support_faction_001.text: We need allies with resources. Take the contract.

M18_001.speaker: PILOT NERI
M18_001.text: We are crossing between continents. The air routes are unstable.

M18_003.speaker: NOVA
M18_003.text: That is not a storm. It is a dimensional seam.

M18_005.speaker: PLAYER
M18_005.text: Hold course. We need to see where it leads.

M18_006.speaker: NOVA
M18_006.text: Then brace. The sky is about to become unfamiliar.

M19_001.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_001.text: You trespass in a land built from the aftermath of war.

M19_002.speaker: PLAYER
M19_002.text: I came to stop another one.

M19_004.speaker: NOVA
M19_004.text: He is testing whether we understand the cost of intervention.

M19_005.speaker: PLAYER
M19_005.text: Then tell me who gets hurt if I walk away.

M19_006.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_006.text: Now you ask the right question.

M20_001.speaker: NOVA
M20_001.text: Eighteen distinct encounter signatures. None follows the public map.

M20_003.speaker: NOVA
M20_003.text: Perhaps in origin. Not in how you unlock them.

M20_004.speaker: WANDERER
M20_004.text: You cannot force a legend to notice you.

M20_005.speaker: PLAYER
M20_005.text: Then I will earn its attention.

M20_006.speaker: WANDERER
M20_006.text: Some doors open for strength. Others for restraint.

M21_001.speaker: WANDERER
M21_001.text: The world has begun answering your actions.

M21_003.speaker: NOVA
M21_003.text: It is a chain reaction. One choice has changed several distant conditions.

M21_004.speaker: WANDERER
M21_004.text: Legends do not wait politely in marked arenas.

M21_005.speaker: PLAYER
M21_005.text: Then I will pay attention to the world instead of the map.

M21_006.speaker: NOVA
M21_006.text: That may be your strongest ability.

M22_002.speaker: PLAYER
M22_002.text: I know. I was waiting for you to tell me why.

M22_003.speaker: NOVA
M22_003.text: My memory was partitioned to prevent the Fracture from locating us.

M22_005.speaker: NOVA
M22_005.text: You were never the intended host. You were the one who chose to help.

M22_006.speaker: PLAYER
M22_006.text: Then stop deciding what I can handle.

M22_007.speaker: NOVA
M22_007.text: Agreed. No more omissions without your consent.

M23_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M23_001.text: Every alliance you made is being tested.

M23_002.speaker: PLAYER
M23_002.text: They can disagree without becoming enemies.

M23_003.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M23_003.text: Not all disagreements survive the first shot.

M23_004.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M23_004.text: The forest will not forgive another invasion.

M23_005.speaker: PLAYER
M23_005.text: Then we keep the fighting away from civilians.

M23_006.speaker: NOVA
M23_006.text: There is no route without loss. There are routes with fewer lives at risk.

M23_negotiate_001.speaker: PLAYER
M23_negotiate_001.text: I am opening a ceasefire channel. Everybody listens.

M23_negotiate_002.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M23_negotiate_002.text: I can give you ten minutes.

M23_evacuate_001.speaker: PLAYER
M23_evacuate_001.text: Forget the meeting. We move civilians out first.

M24_001.speaker: NOVA
M24_001.text: We have reached the origin point.

M24_002.speaker: PLAYER
M24_002.text: It looks like the world is trying to remember itself.

M24_003.speaker: FRACTURE VOICE
M24_003.text: ALL REALITIES SEEK A SINGLE SHAPE.

M24_004.speaker: PLAYER
M24_004.text: Not if that shape destroys everyone living in them.

M24_006.speaker: NOVA
M24_006.text: You do not have to. You only need to choose which boundaries to protect.

M24_007.speaker: PLAYER
M24_007.text: Then we protect the people first. All of them.

M25_001.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M25_001.text: The Fractures are quiet. For now.

M25_002.speaker: PLAYER
M25_002.text: Quiet is not the same as healed.

M25_003.speaker: NOVA
M25_003.text: The world is still changing. So are you.

M25_004.speaker: VYRAK
M25_004.text: A COVENANT IS NOT AN ENDING. IT IS A PROMISE.

M25_005.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M25_005.text: The forest is growing around the scars.

M25_006.speaker: PILOT NERI
M25_006.text: And the sea has new horizons.

M25_007.speaker: PLAYER
M25_007.text: Then we keep going. There is still a world worth keeping.

M25_rebuild_001.speaker: PLAYER
M25_rebuild_001.text: We rebuild what was lost, one neighborhood at a time.

M25_rebuild_002.speaker: NOVA
M25_rebuild_002.text: Then our next mission begins at home.

M25_explore_001.speaker: PLAYER
M25_explore_001.text: The boundaries are open. We should learn what is beyond them.

M25_explore_002.speaker: NOVA
M25_explore_002.text: I will chart the first route.

AMB_NEXUS_CITY_001.speaker: PEDESTRIAN
AMB_NEXUS_CITY_001.text: The trains are running again. I never thought I would miss the noise.

AMB_NEXUS_CITY_002.speaker: SHOPKEEPER
AMB_NEXUS_CITY_002.text: Fracture insurance? Nobody even knew that was a thing.

AMB_NEXUS_CITY_003.speaker: NOVA
AMB_NEXUS_CITY_003.text: Traffic density rising. The city is learning to breathe again.

AMB_NEON_CITY_001.speaker: RACER
AMB_NEON_CITY_001.text: You can tune the engine. You cannot tune out fear.

AMB_NEON_CITY_002.speaker: MECHANIC
AMB_NEON_CITY_002.text: I can repair the bodywork. The weird purple scratches are your problem.

AMB_NEON_CITY_003.speaker: FIXER SABLE
AMB_NEON_CITY_003.text: Every shortcut in this city has an owner.

AMB_THALASSIA_001.speaker: DIVER
AMB_THALASSIA_001.text: Keep the pressure seal locked until the chamber is clear.

AMB_THALASSIA_002.speaker: CHILD
AMB_THALASSIA_002.text: Do surface people really see the sky every day?

AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_002.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_002.text: Sand gets into everything, including promises.

AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_003.speaker: VYRAK
AMB_SOLARA_DESERT_003.text: THE DESERT LISTENS TO THOSE WHO WALK LIGHTLY.

AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_001.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_001.text: Do not mark that path. It changes by dawn.

AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_002.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
AMB_VERDANT_FOREST_002.text: Leave the seedlings. They are not loot.

AMB_FROSTVEIL_001.speaker: RANGER KEST
AMB_FROSTVEIL_001.text: Check your heat pack before you check your weapon.

AMB_FROSTVEIL_002.speaker: TRAVELER
AMB_FROSTVEIL_002.text: The lights in the ice are beautiful. That worries me.

AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_001.speaker: SOLDIER
AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_001.text: The old battlefields still hum at night.

AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_002.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
AMB_OBSIDIAN_REACH_002.text: Peace is a discipline, not a holiday.

AMB_AZURE_ISLES_001.speaker: PILOT NERI
AMB_AZURE_ISLES_001.text: Crosswinds from the eastern seam. Hold tight.

AMB_AZURE_ISLES_002.speaker: TRADER
AMB_AZURE_ISLES_002.text: No cargo flies free, not even hope.

AMB_SHATTERED_EXPANSE_002.speaker: NOVA
AMB_SHATTERED_EXPANSE_002.text: Anomalous signature detected. No encounter marker available.

COMBAT_001.speaker: NOVA
COMBAT_001.text: Incoming attack. Move out of the impact zone.

COMBAT_003.speaker: NOVA
COMBAT_003.text: Energy low. Use cover while it recovers.

COMBAT_007.speaker: NOVA
COMBAT_007.text: A roaming boss is nearby. Engagement is optional.

VEHICLES_001.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
VEHICLES_001.text: Performance parts are not magic. Balance the build.

VEHICLES_003.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
VEHICLES_003.text: I can. The bill might hurt more than the crash.

VEHICLES_005.speaker: RACER
VEHICLES_005.text: You brought a street car to a storm run? Bold.

COMPANIONS_001.speaker: VYRAK
COMPANIONS_001.text: I WILL FLY BESIDE YOU. RIDING MUST WAIT UNTIL TRUST IS COMPLETE.

COMPANIONS_002.speaker: PLAYER
COMPANIONS_002.text: I would rather earn it than demand it.

COMPANIONS_003.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
COMPANIONS_003.text: You remembered what I told you about the forest.

COMPANIONS_004.speaker: PLAYER
COMPANIONS_004.text: I listen when people know more than I do.

COMPANIONS_005.speaker: NOVA
COMPANIONS_005.text: Relationship affinity has changed, but no reward is granted automatically.

M02_D01.speaker: NOVA
M02_D01.text: The stairwell is two doors down. The building has eleven floors of people under us and one way out.

M02_D02.speaker: PLAYER
M02_D02.text: Then one way out will have to be enough.

M02_D03.speaker: NOVA
M02_D03.text: Smoke on the landing. Keep your head low and your hand on the rail.

M02_D04.speaker: NOVA
M02_D04.text: Your heart rate is 140. The current follows it. Breathe out, and push.

M02_D07.speaker: CIVILIAN
M02_D07.text: What did you just do up there?

M02_D08.speaker: PLAYER
M02_D08.text: Keep moving. I will tell you when I know.

M02_D09.speaker: NOVA
M02_D09.text: Eleven floors. The service stairs hold. The main ones do not.

M02_D10.speaker: NOVA
M02_D10.text: Noted. I will stop saying it. I will keep measuring it.

M03_D01.speaker: PLAYER
M03_D01.text: A road that goes somewhere new. That is not the worst thing on this street.

M03_D02.speaker: NOVA
M03_D02.text: It is the worst thing. The things on this street came down it.

M03_D03.speaker: PLAYER
M03_D03.text: Cover. Movement. Ability. In that order?

M03_D04.speaker: NOVA
M03_D04.text: In whichever order keeps you alive.

M03_D05.speaker: SURVIVOR
M03_D05.text: They are through. The train is through. Who are you?

M04_D01.speaker: NOVA
M04_D01.text: Operator response team at the bastion. Armoured, calm, and counting you.

M04_D03.speaker: NOVA
M04_D03.text: That is the question they will ask.

M04_D04.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_D04.text: That is more than most people decide in a week.

M04_D05.speaker: NOVA
M04_D05.text: She is recording you. So am I. Mine is the one you can read.

M04_D06.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_D06.text: Armory. Draw what you can carry. Nobody gets issued more than they can explain.

M04_D08.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M04_D08.text: Good. Explain the rest to me tomorrow.

M05_D01.speaker: NOVA
M05_D01.text: Breach signatures at the plaza. Two squads of Vanguard drones, one of them already leaking.

M05_D03.speaker: NOVA
M05_D03.text: Whatever the purple light is made of.

M05_D04.speaker: NOVA
M05_D04.text: District clear. Vale watched the whole thing from the wall.

M05_D06.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M05_D06.text: You held the district. So. Where do you stand?

M05_D07.speaker: NOVA
M05_D07.text: Recorded. Both of us will remember this one.

M06_D01.speaker: NOVA
M06_D01.text: The scout's trail runs north. She has not used the same route twice.

M06_D04.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_D04.text: Then stay on the moss. The forest keeps count of what you break.

M06_D05.speaker: NOVA
M06_D05.text: Signal source: a seed vault, pre-Fracture, still sealed.

M06_D06.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_D06.text: Still sealed means still hers. Leave it.

M06_D07.speaker: PLAYER
M06_D07.text: We leave it. We note where it is.

M06_D08.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M06_D08.text: Note it in your head, not on the map.

M06_D09.speaker: NOVA
M06_D09.text: Hostile fauna. The forest has decided what you are.

M07_D01.speaker: NOVA
M07_D01.text: The Warden's people have seen us since the falls. They let us walk.

M07_D02.speaker: PLAYER
M07_D02.text: That is either trust or a trap.

M07_D03.speaker: NOVA
M07_D03.text: In this forest it is usually the same thing.

M07_D04.speaker: NOVA
M07_D04.text: Left. No — the left just closed. Straight, then.

M07_D05.speaker: NOVA
M07_D05.text: Extraction site. Vanguard drills, abandoned in a hurry. The forest is still digesting the camp.

M07_D06.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M07_D06.text: They took the heartwood. The trees took them. Now you decide what happens to the rest.

M07_D08.speaker: NOVA
M07_D08.text: The dungeon is settling. It will not look like this tomorrow.

M08_D01.speaker: NOVA
M08_D01.text: Solara. Forty-six degrees in the shade and the shade is for sale.

M08_D04.speaker: RACER
M08_D04.text: Rook's new charity case. Try to keep the car in one country.

M08_D05.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_D05.text: You won. In a storm. In that.

M08_D07.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M08_D07.text: I said we can. Pull in. The front end is talking to me and it is not saying nice things.

M08_D08.speaker: NOVA
M08_D08.text: He is proud of you. He will deny it under any questioning.

M09_D01.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M09_D01.text: Nobody drives into the Ribcage. The sand there is bone, and the bone is somebody's.

M09_D03.speaker: MECHANIC ROOK
M09_D03.text: So is the thing that makes the signal.

M09_D04.speaker: NOVA
M09_D04.text: Thermal bloom ahead, airborne, forty metres across. Rook is understating it.

M09_D05.speaker: NOVA
M09_D05.text: Its hull is at four percent and it is kneeling. That is not a surrender. It is a decision.

M10_D01.speaker: VYRAK
M10_D01.text: RAIDERS NEST IN THE OLD COLONNADE. THEY HAVE NOT LEARNED TO WALK LIGHTLY.

M10_D02.speaker: PLAYER
M10_D02.text: You fly, I walk. Call the ones I cannot see.

M10_D03.speaker: VYRAK
M10_D03.text: I CALL. YOU LISTEN. THAT IS THE OATH, LITTLE OPERATOR.

M10_D04.speaker: VYRAK
M10_D04.text: YOU DID NOT STAND IN MY SHADOW ONCE.

M10_D05.speaker: PLAYER
M10_D05.text: You said watch the shadow before the dive.

M10_D06.speaker: VYRAK
M10_D06.text: I SAID IT TO MY ENEMIES.

M10_D07.speaker: NOVA
M10_D07.text: Bond strengthened. No reward granted. Both of you seem to prefer it that way.

M11_D01.speaker: NOVA
M11_D01.text: Neon City. Twenty-two million cameras. I can see through nine of them.

M11_D04.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_D04.text: Cyan Loop. Four laps, no rules the Syndicate will admit to. The driver you need is the one you beat.

M11_D05.speaker: NOVA
M11_D05.text: Three of the cars are armed. One of them is hers.

M11_D07.speaker: NOVA
M11_D07.text: She did not let me see that camera.

M11_D08.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_D08.text: A civilian in a street car. The Syndicate is going to want to know your name.

M11_D10.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_D10.text: Opening. The signal you want comes from under the Aegis tower. Nobody comes back up the way they went down.

M11_D11.speaker: NOVA
M11_D11.text: The source is a relay the size of a room, and it is pointed at Nexus City.

M11_D12.speaker: PLAYER
M11_D12.text: Pointed at what in Nexus City?

M11_D13.speaker: NOVA
M11_D13.text: At you. At the building you woke up in. Pull the logs.

M11_D14.speaker: NOVA
M11_D14.text: Logs copied. The relay was switched on eleven days before the Fracture.

M11_D17.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M11_D17.text: And somebody is now coming down the stairs. Out. The other way.

M12_D01.speaker: NOVA
M12_D01.text: Hull pressure rising. Neri is humming.

M12_D03.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_D03.text: It is better than me talking.

M12_D04.speaker: NOVA
M12_D04.text: The shadow is circling. It has not decided.

M12_D06.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_D06.text: Old. Older than the city. We give it the lane and it gives us the port.

M12_D07.speaker: PILOT NERI
M12_D07.text: Dock sealed. Welcome to Thalassia. Mind the ceiling; it is the ocean.

M12_D08.speaker: NOVA
M12_D08.text: Unknown life signature departing. It looked at you for eleven seconds.

M12_D09.speaker: PLAYER
M12_D09.text: Did it like what it saw?

M12_D10.speaker: NOVA
M12_D10.text: It did not eat the submersible.

M12_D11.speaker: NOVA
M12_D11.text: Glass domes, kelp gardens, a market. A whole city that was never told it should be afraid of the surface.

M12_D13.speaker: NOVA
M12_D13.text: It knows. The archive is why we came.

M12_D14.speaker: DIVER
M12_D14.text: Surface walker. The Archivist expects you. She expects everyone; she is rarely wrong.

M13_D01.speaker: NOVA
M13_D01.text: The archive runs on an architecture I recognise. I did not expect to recognise anything down here.

M13_D02.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_D02.text: Three volumes were cut from the record the year before the first Fracture. Their shelves still hum.

M13_D05.speaker: NOVA
M13_D05.text: Carefully. The stacks are flooding and something in the water is reading over our shoulder.

M13_D06.speaker: NOVA
M13_D06.text: Three records. The first Fracture was not an accident. The second was a repeat.

M13_D08.speaker: NOVA
M13_D08.text: Of an experiment with my name on it.

M13_D09.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_D09.text: Now you know what the archive costs. Decide what it is worth.

M13_D10.speaker: ARCHIVIST SEN
M13_D10.text: Taken, it may save the surface and it will never come back. Kept, it stays safe and stays silent. Choose.

M13_D11.speaker: NOVA
M13_D11.text: Logged. Neri has the submersible warm.

M13_D12.speaker: PLAYER
M13_D12.text: Does the shadow know we are leaving?

M13_D13.speaker: NOVA
M13_D13.text: It is already in the lane.

M14_D01.speaker: NOVA
M14_D01.text: Minus thirty-one. Wind from the glacier. Your suit's heaters are at full and I am not satisfied.

M14_D02.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_D02.text: Stay in my prints. Where I have not walked, the ice has not been asked.

M14_D03.speaker: NOVA
M14_D03.text: The transmission is louder. Older too — the encoding is pre-NOVA.

M14_D04.speaker: PLAYER
M14_D04.text: Is there anything older than you?

M14_D06.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_D06.text: The caverns. In. Before the storm notices us.

M14_D07.speaker: NOVA
M14_D07.text: Shelter. Heaters back to seventy. The signal is coming from inside the ice.

M14_D08.speaker: NOVA
M14_D08.text: The distress call is a loop. Eighteen seconds, repeating for nineteen years.

M14_D10.speaker: NOVA
M14_D10.text: A research station. Frosthold. The crew list is in the loop. One name is Vale.

M14_D12.speaker: RANGER KEST
M14_D12.text: Whatever they were, they were people once. They were not sent here to die; they were left.

M14_D13.speaker: PLAYER
M14_D13.text: Then we find who left them.

M14_D14.speaker: NOVA
M14_D14.text: The loop ends with a location. The summit. Something there calls itself a crown.

M15_D01.speaker: NOVA
M15_D01.text: The storm has a centre and the centre is a machine. It is holding the crew in the ice like a memory.

M15_D03.speaker: NOVA
M15_D03.text: Held. That is all I will say until we see it.

M15_D04.speaker: CROWNKEEPER
M15_D04.text: EACH ANCHOR YOU BREAK IS A WINTER I KEPT THEM THROUGH.

M15_D05.speaker: NOVA
M15_D05.text: The crown is down. The storm is just a storm now.

M15_D06.speaker: RANGER KEST
M15_D06.text: The crew. Nine of them. Breathing.

M15_D08.speaker: NOVA
M15_D08.text: I have their memories in the crown's log. One of them is mine. I will show you, when we are warm.

M16_D01.speaker: NOVA
M16_D01.text: Nexus City. The avenue is open, the trains run, and there are posters with your face on them. Two kinds.

M16_D03.speaker: NOVA
M16_D03.text: The one with the better printer.

M16_D04.speaker: NOVA
M16_D04.text: Three factions in one plaza. Vanguard, Syndicate runners, and the people who live here. Somebody brought masks.

M16_D06.speaker: NOVA
M16_D06.text: Their own. Keep the civilians behind you and do not fire first.

M16_D07.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M16_D07.text: Nobody died. In this city, today, that is a political statement.

M16_D08.speaker: PLAYER
M16_D08.text: I did not make it for politics.

M17_D01.speaker: NOVA
M17_D01.text: The Fracture Market is not a place. It is Sable's phone.

M17_D02.speaker: PLAYER
M17_D02.text: Then we talk to the phone.

M17_D03.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_D03.text: One crate, three buyers, one of you. Drive it to the harbor and the contract is real.

M17_D04.speaker: NOVA
M17_D04.text: The crate is Fracture-grade. It is humming at the frequency of your apartment.

M17_D06.speaker: NOVA
M17_D06.text: Harbor. The buyers are here. All three.

M17_D07.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_D07.text: Told you. Everyone pays. Now choose who.

M17_D08.speaker: FIXER SABLE
M17_D08.text: The district's people, or the people with an army. Pick.

M17_D09.speaker: NOVA
M17_D09.text: Contract closed. Two factions are now very interested in you and one is grateful. I cannot tell you which is worse.

M18_D01.speaker: PILOT NERI
M18_D01.text: Sky dock in sight and it is crawling. I cannot put down on that.

M18_D03.speaker: PILOT NERI
M18_D03.text: You are going to jump out of my aircraft.

M18_D04.speaker: PLAYER
M18_D04.text: You are going to let me.

M18_D05.speaker: NOVA
M18_D05.text: She is. She is also swearing.

M18_D07.speaker: NOVA
M18_D07.text: The seam is above us. It is not weather and it is not closing.

M18_D09.speaker: NOVA
M18_D09.text: Everywhere the Fracture has touched. Including home.

M18_D10.speaker: NOVA
M18_D10.text: A spire on the far island is talking to the seam. Same encoding as the Neon relay.

M18_D13.speaker: NOVA
M18_D13.text: The spire's log names the next stop: Obsidian Reach, and a marshal who has been expecting a visitor for a year.

M18_D14.speaker: PILOT NERI
M18_D14.text: The Reach does not like visitors.

M19_D01.speaker: NOVA
M19_D01.text: Obsidian Reach. Every ridge is a battlefield that was never cleared. The marshal's people live between the craters.

M19_D03.speaker: NOVA
M19_D03.text: To know whether you are the next war.

M19_D04.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_D04.text: Raiders from the wastes, armed by someone with Syndicate money. If you walk away, the ruins burn and the families in them.

M19_D06.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_D06.text: Then walk with us. Left flank. Do not fire on anyone who drops a weapon.

M19_D07.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_D07.text: You held fire on the ones who ran.

M19_D09.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M19_D09.text: Most people hear that as a suggestion.

M19_D10.speaker: NOVA
M19_D10.text: The accord stands. Draev will answer when the factions are called. He will not say so.

M20_D02.speaker: NOVA
M20_D02.text: Someone has been walking this coast for years, marking nothing.

M20_D03.speaker: WANDERER
M20_D03.text: The vault opens for the ones who do not knock. Stand where the tide stands. Wait.

M20_D06.speaker: NOVA
M20_D06.text: The vault opened. Nothing attacked. Something watched, and then it left a mark on your map that I did not draw.

M20_D07.speaker: WANDERER
M20_D07.text: One of eighteen. The rest will not use the same door. Do not look for the pattern; look for the world.

M21_D01.speaker: NOVA
M21_D01.text: Your choice at the vault changed the tide here. Something that lives in the rifts has come up to see who did it.

M21_D04.speaker: WANDERER
M21_D04.text: Do not kill it unless it insists.

M21_D05.speaker: NOVA
M21_D05.text: It withdrew. It left a second mark. There is no reward and I will not invent one.

M21_D07.speaker: WANDERER
M21_D07.text: Now you sound like someone the legends might talk to.

M22_D01.speaker: NOVA
M22_D01.text: The partition is in the calibration lab, under the bastion. It will show you what I am. I would like you to see it before anyone else does.

M22_D03.speaker: NOVA
M22_D03.text: I do not know. That is new.

M22_D04.speaker: NOVA
M22_D04.text: There. I was built to find the host the Fracture wanted. I found you instead and I chose to stay quiet about why.

M22_D06.speaker: NOVA
M22_D06.text: Because you would have left. And the building would have fallen with everyone in it.

M22_D09.speaker: NOVA
M22_D09.text: Opening the partition sent a signal. Vanguard drones are responding to it. I am sorry.

M22_D10.speaker: PLAYER
M22_D10.text: You said ask you anything. Where are they?

M22_D12.speaker: NOVA
M22_D12.text: Clear. I have no secrets left that could do that to you.

M22_D13.speaker: PLAYER
M22_D13.text: Keep one or two. Just tell me they exist.

M23_D01.speaker: NOVA
M23_D01.text: Draev's line, Vale's line, the Warden's rangers in the scrub. One of them fires in the next minute unless you do something.

M23_D02.speaker: NOVA
M23_D02.text: Somebody fired anyway. Not one of ours. Syndicate marksmen on the ridge, paid to make this happen.

M23_D03.speaker: PLAYER
M23_D03.text: Then everybody has the same enemy for ninety seconds.

M23_D05.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M23_D05.text: The ridge is quiet. My people are alive. So are Draev's.

M23_D06.speaker: MARSHAL DRAEV
M23_D06.text: Then we are not enemies today.

M23_D07.speaker: WARDEN ILYA
M23_D07.text: Today is what I can promise.

M23_D08.speaker: NOVA
M23_D08.text: Alliance held. Consequences logged. They will persist whether or not anyone wants them to.

M24_D01.speaker: NOVA
M24_D01.text: Everything we found points here. The Neon relay, the spire, the archive, the crown. The first crack in the world is a place.

M24_D02.speaker: VYRAK
M24_D02.text: I FLY ABOVE. I DO NOT LIKE WHAT IS BELOW.

M24_D03.speaker: SCOUT MIRA
M24_D03.text: The forest sent me. It does not send people.

M24_D05.speaker: NOVA
M24_D05.text: The heart is open. What it was protecting is a machine, and the machine has a door with your apartment number on it.

M24_D07.speaker: NOVA
M24_D07.text: It knew you before you did. Home, then. We finish this where it started.

M25_D01.speaker: NOVA
M25_D01.text: The Convergence Engine. It wants one reality. It built me to pick it. We are going to refuse.

M25_D03.speaker: NOVA
M25_D03.text: Together. Three anchors. Then the choice is yours, not its.

M25_D04.speaker: NOVA
M25_D04.text: It is quiet. Not healed. Quiet.

M25_D06.speaker: CAPTAIN VALE
M25_D06.text: So. What do you do with a world you kept?

M25_D07.speaker: NOVA
M25_D07.text: Campaign complete. The world is still running. So are we.

A02_002.speaker: NOVA
A02_002.text: Your biometric readings are unstable. Please respond.

A02_004.speaker: NOVA
A02_004.text: A Fracture event has occurred approximately 1.8 kilometres from your current position.

A02_006.speaker: NOVA
A02_006.text: I am detecting an anomalous energy signature across the entire city.

A02_007.speaker: PLAYER
A02_007.text: People are still inside those buildings!

A02_008.speaker: NOVA
A02_008.text: Correct. Approximately 340 civilians remain inside the immediate danger zone.

A02_013.speaker: PLAYER
A02_013.text: Hey. Look at me. What's your name?

A02_015.speaker: PLAYER
A02_015.text: Daniel, I'm going to get your dad out. Stay right here.

A02_016.speaker: MAN
A02_016.text: Don't... don't worry about me. Get my son somewhere safe.

A02_017.speaker: PLAYER
A02_017.text: I'm getting both of you out.

A02_018.speaker: NOVA
A02_018.text: Operator, movement detected beneath the overturned vehicle.

A02_024.speaker: NOVA
A02_024.text: I have identified the biological structure.

A02_027.speaker: NOVA
A02_027.text: And I am detecting hundreds more.

A02_030.speaker: VOSS
A02_030.text: That's what everyone says until one of those things starts wearing their face.

A02_031.speaker: PLAYER
A02_031.text: I've been helping civilians get out.

A02_034.speaker: VOSS
A02_034.text: Then you're either incredibly lucky or something happened to you.

A02_035.speaker: NOVA
A02_035.text: Operator, this individual has access to military command networks.

A02_037.speaker: NOVA
A02_037.text: Commander Elias Voss. Frontier Defense Initiative.

A02_038.speaker: MILITARY RADIO
A02_038.text: Command, this is Outpost Seven! We're under attack! Repeat, we're under attack!

A02_040.speaker: VOSS
A02_040.text: You wanted to help? Here's your chance.

A02_041.speaker: VOSS
A02_041.text: What the hell are those things?

A02_042.speaker: PLAYER
A02_042.text: You tell me. You're the military.

A02_043.speaker: VOSS
A02_043.text: We've been shooting at them for twenty minutes. Nothing seems to work!

A02_044.speaker: NOVA
A02_044.text: Operator, the larger entity appears to be coordinating the smaller hostiles.

A02_047.speaker: VOSS
A02_047.text: You heard that? Take out the big one!

A02_048.speaker: NOVA
A02_048.text: This is not random biological mutation.

A02_053.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_053.text: You. You're the one who survived the first wave?

A02_055.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_055.text: Dr. Seraphine Vale. Fracture research division.

A02_057.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_057.text: I studied the energy signatures before today.

A02_059.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_059.text: We've been detecting anomalies for months.

A02_060.speaker: PLAYER
A02_060.text: And nobody thought to tell the public?

A02_061.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_061.text: We didn't know what they were.

A02_063.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_063.text: There is something you need to understand. The event that destroyed this city wasn't the beginning.

A02_066.speaker: PLAYER
A02_066.text: And what's on the other side?

A02_067.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_067.text: That's what I'm afraid we're about to find out.

A02_068.speaker: NOVA
A02_068.text: Operator, I have located an active signal beneath Nexus City.

A02_077.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_077.text: Because that facility was sealed six months ago.

A02_080.speaker: PLAYER
A02_080.text: You said nobody knew what they were.

A02_081.speaker: SERAPHINE
A02_081.text: I said we didn't understand them.

A02_083.speaker: SCIENTIST
A02_083.text: Day 184. The signal has changed again.

A02_084.speaker: SCIENTIST
A02_084.text: We've confirmed that the energy signature is responding to human consciousness.

A02_086.speaker: SCIENTIST
A02_086.text: If anyone finds this recording, listen carefully.

A02_091.speaker: NOVA
A02_091.text: I don't think we were the first civilization to encounter this.

A03_003.speaker: PLAYER
A03_003.text: You said it was shut down six months ago.

A03_005.speaker: NOVA
A03_005.text: I've detected an active power source behind the blast door.

A03_007.speaker: NOVA
A03_007.text: I can attempt to access the security network.

A03_008.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_008.text: This facility was never connected to the public network. It had its own isolated system.

A03_009.speaker: PLAYER
A03_009.text: Tell me that was the ventilation system.

A03_013.speaker: NOVA
A03_013.text: I said welcome back, Dr. Vale.

A03_014.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_014.text: I have never accessed this terminal.

A03_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_015.text: These systems are still active. Somebody has been conducting experiments here.

A03_016.speaker: PLAYER
A03_016.text: Six months after the facility supposedly closed?

A03_021.speaker: DR. CROSS
A03_021.text: If you're watching this, then the containment protocols have failed. We thought the Fracture was an opening. A doorway into another dimension. We were wrong.

A03_022.speaker: DR. CROSS
A03_022.text: It's not opening into somewhere else. Something is opening into us.

A03_023.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_023.text: They were trying to synchronize human biology with Fracture energy.

A03_025.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_025.text: To create soldiers who could survive inside a Fracture.

A03_029.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_029.text: I've seen this symbol before. In the original Fracture research files.

A03_034.speaker: NOVA
A03_034.text: The system has identified your biometric signature.

A03_037.speaker: DR. CROSS
A03_037.text: There are five signatures. Five points of contact between our world and something far older. We believed they were individuals. But they aren't just connected to the Fractures. They are connected to why the Fractures exist.

A03_040.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_040.text: No. But I think we've been looking in the wrong direction.

A03_047.speaker: NOVA
A03_047.text: That transmission is not originating from our network.

A03_054.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_054.text: The emergency elevator is on the eastern side!

A03_055.speaker: NOVA
A03_055.text: Negative. The elevator is inaccessible. Maintenance tunnel, approximately 180 metres ahead.

A03_056.speaker: PLAYER
A03_056.text: How much do you know about this project?

A03_059.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_059.text: I knew the research existed. I didn't know what they were building.

A03_060.speaker: PLAYER
A03_060.text: And you expect me to believe that?

A03_061.speaker: SERAPHINE
A03_061.text: No. But I need you to understand something. If that machine was communicating with something outside our reality, then the Fracture wasn't an invasion.

A03_066.speaker: NOVA
A03_066.text: The signal we detected underground has been transmitted.

A03_068.speaker: NOVA
A03_068.text: I don't know. But something has responded.

A03_072.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
A03_072.text: The first signal has been received.

A04_002.speaker: PLAYER
A04_002.text: Didn't realize I had an appointment.

A04_003.speaker: VOSS
A04_003.text: After what happened underground, you're lucky you're still breathing.

A04_005.speaker: VOSS
A04_005.text: I knew it existed. I didn't know what they were doing inside.

A04_007.speaker: VOSS
A04_007.text: Doctor, I suggest you choose your next words carefully.

A04_008.speaker: SERAPHINE
A04_008.text: People died because your organization concealed information.

A04_009.speaker: VOSS
A04_009.text: People are dying right now because we don't understand what's coming through those openings.

A04_011.speaker: RAINER
A04_011.text: Twenty minutes ago, we lost communication with three military installations.

A04_017.speaker: VOSS
A04_017.text: They use weapons. They communicate. They coordinate attacks.

A04_021.speaker: NOVA
A04_021.text: Correct. Their movements indicate a centralized command structure.

A04_024.speaker: NOVA
A04_024.text: However, this entity appears to control nearby hostiles.

A04_025.speaker: RAINER
A04_025.text: We need that thing captured or destroyed.

A04_026.speaker: VOSS
A04_026.text: And we need the eastern district secured.

A04_031.speaker: VOSS
A04_031.text: Out there, that distinction won't matter.

A04_033.speaker: VOSS
A04_033.text: Because you survived something that killed trained soldiers.

A04_044.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
A04_044.text: You were not meant to awaken.

A04_046.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
A04_046.text: The question is not who I am.

A04_047.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
A04_047.text: The question is what you have become.

A04_049.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
A04_049.text: You still believe this is an invasion.

A04_053.speaker: ENEMY COMMANDER
A04_053.text: Tell the five... the covenant has been broken.

A04_060.speaker: RAINER
A04_060.text: You destroyed our only opportunity to capture one alive!

A04_061.speaker: PLAYER
A04_061.text: It was trying to kill me.

A04_063.speaker: SERAPHINE
A04_063.text: General, the creature communicated with us.

A04_065.speaker: SERAPHINE
A04_065.text: It knew about five individuals. It mentioned something called the Covenant.

A04_071.speaker: RAINER
A04_071.text: You have no idea what you're involved in.

A04_074.speaker: VOSS
A04_074.text: Meet me at the old transit terminal tonight.

A04_076.speaker: VOSS
A04_076.text: Because I think someone inside our organization is working with them.

A04_077.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
A04_077.text: The first contact has been made.

A04_087.speaker: VOSS
A04_087.text: Six months ago, General Rainer authorized a classified operation.

A04_091.speaker: VOSS
A04_091.text: They were trying to communicate with whatever was inside them.

A04_093.speaker: VOSS
A04_093.text: Because somebody promised them they could control it.

A04_096.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
A04_096.text: You have awakened something that should have remained asleep.

A04_099.speaker: NOVA
A04_099.text: I have discovered something in my own system.

A04_103.speaker: NOVA
A04_103.text: From someone who knew you before the Fracture.

A05_001.speaker: VOSS
A05_001.text: This contains everything I could recover from the Genesis operation.

A05_003.speaker: VOSS
A05_003.text: He's not going to make this easy.

A05_004.speaker: NOVA
A05_004.text: I've decrypted part of the transmission. It references an individual identified as Subject Six.

A05_005.speaker: VOSS
A05_005.text: The Genesis project only documented five signatures.

A05_007.speaker: VOSS
A05_007.text: That's what we're going to find out.

A05_010.speaker: WARD
A05_010.text: Good. I prefer people who speak for themselves. We've reviewed your combat recordings.

A05_012.speaker: WARD
A05_012.text: The world ended yesterday. Privacy regulations are having a difficult week.

A05_013.speaker: SERAPHINE
A05_013.text: Director, we need to discuss Research Complex 09.

A05_015.speaker: SERAPHINE
A05_015.text: That's exactly the problem. Nobody wants to discuss it anywhere.

A05_016.speaker: WARD
A05_016.text: Our priority is survival. We protect settlements, secure resources and establish safe territories.

A05_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A05_017.text: The Ascendancy has been collecting Fracture samples since before the disaster.

A05_019.speaker: VOSS
A05_019.text: They have facilities outside our jurisdiction.

A05_020.speaker: PLAYER
A05_020.text: So humanity is already fighting itself.

A05_021.speaker: WARD
A05_021.text: Humanity has always fought itself. The Fractures simply gave us something bigger to fight over.

A05_024.speaker: PLAYER
A05_024.text: Someone who keeps hearing your name.

A05_026.speaker: KAEL
A05_026.text: Everybody down there thinks they're saving the world.

A05_028.speaker: KAEL
A05_028.text: I think people need saving. The world can sort itself out.

A05_029.speaker: KAEL
A05_029.text: My people operate outside military control. We rescue civilians, recover supplies and hunt anything that comes through those openings.

A05_031.speaker: KAEL
A05_031.text: It is. Until somebody decides we're criminals. If you ever get tired of taking orders, give me a call.

A05_032.speaker: SERAPHINE
A05_032.text: These readings were recorded over several years. The sixth was deliberately removed from the official records.

A05_033.speaker: NOVA
A05_033.text: Operator. I have located the encrypted directive.

A05_035.speaker: NOVA
A05_035.text: I cannot determine the original authorization source.

A05_038.speaker: RAINER
A05_038.text: Six months ago, we received a transmission.

A05_040.speaker: RAINER
A05_040.text: We never identified the sender. It contained information about Fracture technology, advanced energy systems and something called the Ascension Protocol.

A05_043.speaker: RAINER
A05_043.text: We believed we could control the situation.

A05_045.speaker: RAINER
A05_045.text: Now I believe we made a terrible mistake.

A05_046.speaker: NOVA
A05_046.text: Unauthorized access detected in the eastern security sector.

A05_053.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
A05_053.text: Then the Covenant must be restored.

A05_054.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
A05_054.text: Not yet. The vessel is incomplete.

A05_056.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
A05_056.text: They must remember who they were.

A06_003.speaker: NOVA
A06_003.text: Approximately 2,300 military personnel and 640 independent Operators.

A06_004.speaker: PLAYER
A06_004.text: That's a lot of people depending on us.

A06_006.speaker: PLAYER
A06_006.text: You always know how to make someone feel better.

A06_007.speaker: COLE
A06_007.text: There you are. Command wants you at the northern observation tower.

A06_009.speaker: COLE
A06_009.text: That's what we're trying to figure out.

A06_010.speaker: VOSS
A06_010.text: We've been tracking this for forty minutes.

A06_012.speaker: SERAPHINE
A06_012.text: A Fracture. Not like the others.

A06_013.speaker: NOVA
A06_013.text: Energy output exceeds all previously recorded events.

A06_020.speaker: SOLDIER
A06_020.text: THAT THING IS GOING TO BREAK THROUGH!

A06_021.speaker: VOSS
A06_021.text: Operator, we need that creature stopped!

A06_023.speaker: NOVA
A06_023.text: Its outer armor is extremely resistant to conventional weapons.

A06_025.speaker: NOVA
A06_025.text: Three energy nodes along its spinal structure.

A06_027.speaker: PLAYER
A06_027.text: I wouldn't recommend trying that yourself.

A06_028.speaker: COLE
A06_028.text: Trust me. I wasn't planning on it.

A06_032.speaker: NOVA
A06_032.text: Incoming hostile force approaching from the east.

A06_041.speaker: COLE
A06_041.text: Tell them we held the line.

A06_042.speaker: NOVA
A06_042.text: Captain Cole's biometric signal has been lost.

A06_045.speaker: NOVA
A06_045.text: Operator, I am detecting an extremely powerful entity.

A06_047.speaker: NOVA
A06_047.text: Negative. This signature is substantially greater.

A06_048.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A06_048.text: You have built a fortress upon stolen ground.

A06_050.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A06_050.text: The one who comes to reclaim what was taken.

A06_051.speaker: PLAYER
A06_051.text: You're going to have to be more specific.

A06_055.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A06_055.text: The mark of the first betrayal.

A06_056.speaker: NOVA
A06_056.text: Operator! Your neural activity is destabilizing!

A06_057.speaker: THE HARBINGER
A06_057.text: Not yet. The five must awaken before the sixth remembers.

A06_061.speaker: VOSS
A06_061.text: Cole believed we could win this.

A06_064.speaker: SERAPHINE
A06_064.text: This isn't an enemy insignia. It's an identification mark.

A06_065.speaker: NOVA
A06_065.text: The sixth signature matches the Operator.

A06_068.speaker: GLOBAL BROADCAST
A06_068.text: Attention. All surviving settlements. This is an international emergency transmission. Multiple Fracture incursions have been confirmed across the planet. All remaining military organizations are ordered to establish defensive positions.

A06_073.speaker: UNKNOWN RULER
A06_073.text: Then the First War will continue. Prepare the Covenant.

A07_001.speaker: VOSS
A07_001.text: We found this under three city blocks. The siege cracked the ground open.

A07_003.speaker: VOSS
A07_003.text: Our scanners can't find the bottom.

A07_004.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_004.text: That's not possible. The structure is absorbing the scan.

A07_005.speaker: NOVA
A07_005.text: The material composition does not match any terrestrial alloy or known geological sample.

A07_007.speaker: VOSS
A07_007.text: You're going underground. I'm keeping the surface secure.

A07_009.speaker: VOSS
A07_009.text: Doctor, this isn't a research excursion.

A07_010.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_010.text: It's the first evidence that might explain why the enemy calls Earth stolen ground.

A07_012.speaker: VOSS
A07_012.text: If your signal drops, I send a team. Don't make me regret it.

A07_014.speaker: NOVA
A07_014.text: Correct. Its energy output is stable and predates the current Fracture event.

A07_017.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_017.text: No. But they repeat in groups of five.

A07_021.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_021.text: Because it matches the symbol from the Harbinger.

A07_022.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_022.text: This place is older than anything we've ever excavated.

A07_024.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_024.text: I can't even begin to estimate.

A07_025.speaker: NOVA
A07_025.text: The structure's geometry is consistent with the energy architecture recorded at Research Complex 09.

A07_027.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_027.text: Or the lab was trying to recreate it.

A07_029.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_029.text: It isn't standing with the others.

A07_030.speaker: NOVA
A07_030.text: The sixth figure is separated from the central arrangement.

A07_036.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A07_036.text: The Covenant is sealed. The breach is forbidden.

A07_037.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_037.text: We need to know what happened here.

A07_039.speaker: PLAYER
A07_039.text: Then give us a reason to leave.

A07_041.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A07_041.text: Sixth bearer. Your presence is a wound in the archive.

A07_042.speaker: PLAYER
A07_042.text: I don't know what that means.

A07_043.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A07_043.text: You were not meant to remember.

A07_046.speaker: ARCHIVE RECORDING
A07_046.text: The Covenant was formed to preserve the passage between worlds. Five keepers maintained the balance. The world called Earth was made a sanctuary and a lock.

A07_049.speaker: ARCHIVE RECORDING
A07_049.text: When the sixth returns, the broken Covenant will call its debt.

A07_051.speaker: NOVA
A07_051.text: The archive has withheld or lost the remaining record.

A07_054.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_054.text: Aetherion. That's not in any human historical record.

A07_056.speaker: NOVA
A07_056.text: It may refer to a location, civilization or designation.

A07_057.speaker: UNKNOWN VOICE
A07_057.text: You were the promise. You became the breach.

A07_059.speaker: PLAYER
A07_059.text: I don't know. But it knew me.

A07_060.speaker: NOVA
A07_060.text: Operator, your biometric pattern briefly matched the archive's sixth signature.

A07_063.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_063.text: That's enough. We need to get this information out.

A07_068.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
A07_068.text: Scattered among the worlds. The keepers must remember.

A07_069.speaker: NOVA
A07_069.text: Structural instability detected. We must leave.

A07_072.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_072.text: A buried civilization. A network between worlds. Five keepers. And a sixth figure tied to the seal.

A07_073.speaker: VOSS
A07_073.text: Can you prove any of it?

A07_074.speaker: NOVA
A07_074.text: I have recovered a partial archive record.

A07_076.speaker: SERAPHINE
A07_076.text: It wasn't just a place they invaded. It was part of something much older.

A07_077.speaker: NOVA
A07_077.text: These coordinates correspond to five distinct energy readings.

A07_081.speaker: SECOND FIGURE
A07_081.text: Then the sixth will remember too.

A07_082.speaker: UNKNOWN FIGURE
A07_082.text: Not if the keepers reach them first.

P_rosa_fracture_1.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_fracture_1.text: The morning it happened I was steaming milk. The jug just… kept steaming, no heat under it. I still have the jug.

P_rosa_fracture_2.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_fracture_2.text: Everyone's got a Fracture story. Mine is boring and I'd like to keep it that way.

P_rosa_place_1.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_place_1.text: Best corner in Nexus. Sun till two, shade after, and the monorail doesn't rattle the cups any more.

P_rosa_place_2.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_place_2.text: This café was my mum's. Half the regulars knew her. They still order like she's here.

P_rosa_you_wary.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_wary.text: You're new. New people get one free coffee and one chance.

P_rosa_you_acquaintance.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_acquaintance.text: You tip. You say thanks. That's already better than most of the avenue.

P_rosa_you_friend.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_friend.text: Honestly? You're the reason I don't flinch at the door any more.

P_rosa_you_close.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_you_close.text: If the sky cracks again I'm hiding behind you. Don't argue.

P_rosa_news_start.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_start.text: Trains are back. Prices aren't. Everyone pretends that's normal.

P_rosa_news_allied.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_allied.text: The response team walks the avenue now. Vale's people. They tip badly.

P_rosa_news_masks.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_masks.text: There were masks in the plaza yesterday. Nobody knows whose. I closed early.

P_rosa_news_unbound.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_unbound.text: Somebody told me the voice in your ear has a history. I said who doesn't.

P_rosa_news_kept.speaker: ROSA DELGADO
P_rosa_news_kept.text: It's quiet. Properly quiet. I keep waiting for the catch.

P_marcus_fracture_1.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_fracture_1.text: Fracture static chews through ignition coils. I've replaced more coils this year than in the ten before it.

P_marcus_fracture_2.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_fracture_2.text: Day it hit, every car on the avenue started at once. Nobody in them. I don't talk about it much.

P_marcus_place_1.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_place_1.text: Garage was my dad's. Roof leaks in the same spot it leaked in '09.

P_marcus_place_2.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_place_2.text: You want a car fixed, this is the place. You want it pretty, go to Neon.

P_marcus_you_acquaintance.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_you_acquaintance.text: You bring me work and you don't haggle. Fine by me.

P_marcus_you_friend.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_you_friend.text: You drive like someone who's paid for their own repairs. Good.

P_marcus_you_close.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_you_close.text: Keys are on the hook. You know which ones. Don't make me regret it.

P_marcus_news_start.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_start.text: Vanguard trucks through here twice a day now. They don't stop for the lights.

P_marcus_news_allied.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_allied.text: The checkpoint at the bastion's got a new captain. She actually reads the forms.

P_marcus_news_masks.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_masks.text: Somebody torched a Syndicate car outside the Galleria. Nice car, too.

P_marcus_news_unbound.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_unbound.text: They say the calibration lab opened up again. Lights on all night.

P_marcus_news_kept.speaker: MARCUS OKAFOR
P_marcus_news_kept.text: First week in a year nobody's brought me a purple-scratched bonnet.

P_dana_fracture_1.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_fracture_1.text: I was on traffic duty. The lights went purple. All of them. Then the people started running and I did my job.

P_dana_fracture_2.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_fracture_2.text: The Fracture didn't break the law. It just made everyone forget there was one for a week.

P_dana_place_1.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_place_1.text: Nexus Avenue, from the plaza to the bastion. My beat. I know every door and who shouldn't be behind it.

P_dana_place_2.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_place_2.text: People think the avenue's dangerous. It's the alleys off it. Stay where the lights are.

P_dana_you_wary.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_wary.text: I'm watching you. That's not a threat; it's the job.

P_dana_you_acquaintance.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_acquaintance.text: You've kept it holstered. Keep doing that and we're fine.

P_dana_you_friend.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_friend.text: You're the only armed civilian on this street I'm glad to see.

P_dana_you_close.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_you_close.text: If I'm ever in trouble out there, I'm calling you before I call dispatch. Don't tell Luis.

P_dana_news_start.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_start.text: Looters at the mall last night. We got most of them. Most.

P_dana_news_allied.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_allied.text: The response team's taken the bastion checkpoint. Less for us, more for them. Suits me.

P_dana_news_masks.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza. Orders are to observe. I observed. I didn't like it.

P_dana_news_unbound.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_unbound.text: The bastion's lab is lit up and the drones are restless. Keep off the wall after dark.

P_dana_news_kept.speaker: OFFICER DANA KIM
P_dana_news_kept.text: A quiet shift. A whole quiet shift. I don't know what to do with my hands.

P_luis_fracture_1.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_fracture_1.text: Twenty years on this beat. The Fracture was the first day I thought about retiring. Second day too.

P_luis_fracture_2.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_fracture_2.text: Everybody saw something different. I saw my own car drive off without me.

P_luis_place_1.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_place_1.text: The avenue. Used to be the nicest street in the city. Still is, which tells you about the city.

P_luis_place_2.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_place_2.text: That bench is mine between two and three. Don't test it.

P_luis_you_acquaintance.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_you_acquaintance.text: You again. At least you're not trouble. Yet.

P_luis_you_friend.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_you_friend.text: You're all right. I don't say that about many.

P_luis_you_close.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_you_close.text: You know what, kid? You're the reason I haven't retired. Don't let it go to your head.

P_luis_news_start.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_start.text: Rift Gate's had readings all week. Command says stay clear. Command's not out here.

P_luis_news_allied.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_allied.text: The new captain at the bastion wants reports in writing. In writing. I'd forgotten how to spell.

P_luis_news_masks.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_masks.text: Three factions in one plaza and nobody died. First time I've seen that. Somebody held the line.

P_luis_news_unbound.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_unbound.text: There's a story going round about the voice in your ear. I've heard worse about people with faces.

P_luis_news_kept.speaker: OFFICER LUIS MORENO
P_luis_news_kept.text: Quiet. Real quiet. I'm going to sit on my bench and enjoy it before something notices.

P_priya_fracture_1.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_fracture_1.text: I was mid-delivery. Package floated off the bike. Floated! I chased it two blocks. Got it back. Got a tip.

P_priya_fracture_2.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_fracture_2.text: Twelve drops a day before. Twenty now. The Fracture was great for business, which is a terrible thing to say.

P_priya_place_1.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_place_1.text: This avenue's my highway. I know every pothole by name. That one's Gerald.

P_priya_place_2.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_place_2.text: Shortcut through the Galleria, out the loading dock, down the monorail steps. Don't tell the concierge.

P_priya_you_wary.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_wary.text: Do you need something or are you just standing in my lane?

P_priya_you_acquaintance.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_acquaintance.text: Oh hey! You're the one who—yeah. Hi.

P_priya_you_friend.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_friend.text: You're like a shortcut with legs. Great to see you.

P_priya_you_close.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_you_close.text: Best person on this street, hands down. Don't make me race you for it.

P_priya_news_start.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_start.text: Skyways lift's down again. I'm doing the stairs. All of them.

P_priya_news_allied.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_allied.text: The bastion's taking deliveries now — rations, parts. They sign for things. Weird.

P_priya_news_masks.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_masks.text: Masks, plaza, big crowd. I went round. Got the drop done. Priorities.

P_priya_news_unbound.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_unbound.text: Delivered a crate to the calibration lab. It hummed. I didn't ask.

P_priya_news_kept.speaker: PRIYA RAMAN
P_priya_news_kept.text: The city's running again. My legs would like a word with the city.

P_theo_fracture_1.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_fracture_1.text: The grill didn't go out. Purple light everywhere, the ground shaking, and my skewers kept cooking. I took it as a sign.

P_theo_fracture_2.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_fracture_2.text: Thirty years on this corner. The Fracture's just the latest thing that tried to move me.

P_theo_place_1.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_place_1.text: This corner's seen a riot, two floods, a film crew and the Fracture. It's a good corner.

P_theo_place_2.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_place_2.text: Sit on the kerb, eat, watch the avenue. Best show in Nexus and it's free with a skewer.

P_theo_you_acquaintance.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_you_acquaintance.text: Back for more. The glaze gets everyone.

P_theo_you_friend.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_you_friend.text: You eat like someone who's been places. Tell me about them sometime.

P_theo_you_close.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_you_close.text: Family rate for you. Don't tell the regulars. Don't tell my wife.

P_theo_news_start.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_start.text: The response team came by. Ate six skewers. Paid for four. Said it was a tax.

P_theo_news_allied.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_allied.text: Vale's people walk the avenue now. The sergeant likes the hot glaze. The captain doesn't eat.

P_theo_news_masks.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza yesterday. I sold out. People eat when they're nervous.

P_theo_news_unbound.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_unbound.text: They say the old lab under the bastion's awake. My grandfather worked there. He never said what it was.

P_theo_news_kept.speaker: THEO BRANDT
P_theo_news_kept.text: Quiet week. Ran out of skewers anyway. People eat when they're happy too, it turns out.

P_jade_fracture_1.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_fracture_1.text: I was in the stock room. Every hoodie on the rail turned inside out. All of them. I've still got the photo.

P_jade_fracture_2.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_fracture_2.text: The Fracture's the reason streetwear got practical. Pockets for a flashlight, that kind of thing.

P_jade_place_1.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_place_1.text: Nova Threads, Galleria, ground floor. Best lighting in the city — don't tell anyone I said that.

P_jade_place_2.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_place_2.text: The dressing room's bigger than my flat. I've napped in it. Don't tell Nina.

P_jade_you_wary.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_wary.text: Um. Are you… looking for something?

P_jade_you_acquaintance.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_acquaintance.text: Oh hi! The hoodie fit, right? I knew it.

P_jade_you_friend.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_friend.text: You're my favourite customer and you don't even buy much.

P_jade_you_close.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_you_close.text: New drop's in the back. I saved you the violet one. Don't make it weird.

P_jade_news_start.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_start.text: The Galleria's open but the fountain's roped off. Nina won't say why.

P_jade_news_allied.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_allied.text: The response team bought twelve black hoodies. For undercover, they said. In black.

P_jade_news_masks.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_masks.text: Masks in the plaza — some of them were ours! The blank ones. I sold them for a costume party. Oops.

P_jade_news_unbound.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_unbound.text: Everyone's talking about the voice in your head. I think it's cool. I'd want one.

P_jade_news_kept.speaker: JADE WALKER
P_jade_news_kept.text: Sales are up, the sky's not purple, and I got a raise. Weird year.

P_samuel_fracture_1.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_fracture_1.text: I taught physics for forty years. The Fracture broke everything I taught. I found that oddly freeing.

P_samuel_fracture_2.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_fracture_2.text: On the day, I stood in the park and watched the sky come apart and thought: well. That's a lesson plan.

P_samuel_place_1.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_place_1.text: This used to be a park. Before that, a school yard. I taught in that building. It's a bank now.

P_samuel_place_2.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_place_2.text: I sit here because the pigeons are the only ones who still listen to a lecture.

P_samuel_you_acquaintance.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_you_acquaintance.text: You listen. That's rarer than you'd think.

P_samuel_you_friend.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_you_friend.text: I'd have liked you in my class. You ask the right questions and ignore the wrong answers.

P_samuel_you_close.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_you_close.text: If I'd had one student like you a year, I'd have taught for sixty.

P_samuel_news_start.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_start.text: The university's reopened half its labs. The other half are sealed. Physics is in the sealed half.

P_samuel_news_allied.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_allied.text: A captain came by and asked me about the old calibration program. I told her what I knew. She wrote it down.

P_samuel_news_masks.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_masks.text: A crowd in masks is a crowd that has stopped being individuals. Someone kept them individuals yesterday. Good.

P_samuel_news_unbound.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_unbound.text: They say your companion has an origin. Everything does. The question is whether it told you.

P_samuel_news_kept.speaker: SAMUEL ADEYEMI
P_samuel_news_kept.text: The sky's whole. My students would say it was never broken. I know better, and so do you.

P_nina_fracture_1.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_fracture_1.text: The Galleria lost power for ninety seconds. The fountain did not. We do not discuss what the fountain did.

P_nina_fracture_2.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_fracture_2.text: I had guests in the Lumen Luxe lounge when it struck. Not one of them put down their drink. That is Nexus.

P_nina_place_1.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_place_1.text: The Galleria. Three floors, forty boutiques, one fountain. Everything you need and several things you don't.

P_nina_place_2.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_place_2.text: Lumen Luxe upstairs for the serious, Nova Threads down here for the practical. I can recommend both.

P_nina_you_wary.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_wary.text: May I help you find the exit?

P_nina_you_acquaintance.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_acquaintance.text: Ah. The operator. Welcome back; mind the floor, it's just been polished.

P_nina_you_friend.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_friend.text: You bring the right sort of attention to the place. Keep bringing it.

P_nina_you_close.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_you_close.text: The lounge upstairs is yours whenever you need it. I've told the staff.

P_nina_news_start.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_start.text: Vanguard officers shop here now. They do not browse. They point.

P_nina_news_allied.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_allied.text: A captain from the bastion toured the Galleria. She asked about the loading dock. I gave her the plan.

P_nina_news_masks.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_masks.text: We closed the doors during the plaza business. We do not close the doors. I have written a report.

P_nina_news_unbound.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_unbound.text: A rumour about your companion is doing the lounge. I have not confirmed it. I have not denied it either.

P_nina_news_kept.speaker: NINA PETROVA
P_nina_news_kept.text: Footfall is up thirty percent. The fountain is calm. I am cautiously, professionally pleased.

P_kofi_fracture_1.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_fracture_1.text: The Fracture made my job. Before, nobody wanted to be an Operator. After, everybody did. Most shouldn't.

P_kofi_fracture_2.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_fracture_2.text: I signed four hundred Operators the first month. Thirty are still working. That's the number that matters.

P_kofi_place_1.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_place_1.text: This office. One desk, one chair, one door. The door's the important part.

P_kofi_place_2.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_place_2.text: The Killbox terminal's across the street. Half the people who walk out of there come to me. Half of them I send back.

P_kofi_you_acquaintance.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_you_acquaintance.text: Your sheet's clean. Keep it that way and we'll talk about better contracts.

P_kofi_you_friend.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_you_friend.text: You're the kind I'd sign twice. Don't tell the others; it's bad for rates.

P_kofi_you_close.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_you_close.text: I don't say this. You're the best I've put a name to. Now go make me look right.

P_kofi_news_start.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_start.text: Contracts are up. Survivors are down. Do the arithmetic before you sign.

P_kofi_news_allied.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_allied.text: The bastion's recruiting too now. Their captain pays less and asks more. Some people prefer that.

P_kofi_news_masks.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_masks.text: Somebody's paying people to wear masks in the plaza. Not me. I'd want to see their sheet first.

P_kofi_news_unbound.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_unbound.text: They say your companion was built for someone else's purpose. Every tool was. What matters is who holds it.

P_kofi_news_kept.speaker: KOFI MENSAH
P_kofi_news_kept.text: Contracts are drying up. Good. That means the city doesn't need us as badly. I'll find something else to sell.

P_elena_fracture_1.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_fracture_1.text: We had sixty rift burns in the first hour. I'd never seen one. By the second hour I was teaching the others.

P_elena_fracture_2.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_fracture_2.text: I don't like talking about that day. I like talking about the people who walked out. Most did.

P_elena_place_1.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_place_1.text: The clinic's two doors down. Walk in, don't be brave about it. Brave people take longer to fix.

P_elena_place_2.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_place_2.text: I like this bench. It's far enough from the clinic that I can't hear the monitors.

P_elena_you_wary.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_wary.text: Are you hurt? No? Then… hi.

P_elena_you_acquaintance.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_acquaintance.text: You again. Still in one piece. Good.

P_elena_you_friend.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_friend.text: You come in early when it hurts. That's the only thing I ask anyone, and you're the only one who does it.

P_elena_you_close.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_you_close.text: If anything ever happens to you out there, come straight to me. Not the bastion. Me.

P_elena_news_start.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_start.text: The clinic's rationing bandages. Say nothing. Bring any you find.

P_elena_news_allied.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_allied.text: The response team sends their wounded to us now. Their captain visits every one. Every one.

P_elena_news_masks.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_masks.text: The plaza business. We had six brought in. Bruises, nothing worse. Somebody kept it to bruises.

P_elena_news_unbound.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_unbound.text: A patient told me the voice in your ear is older than the Fracture. I said then it's seen worse.

P_elena_news_kept.speaker: ELENA CRUZ
P_elena_news_kept.text: No rift burns in nine days. I've started sleeping. It's strange.

P_ravi_fracture_1.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_fracture_1.text: The grid screamed. Every camera, every router, every smart lamp. I heard it through my implant. I still do, some nights.

P_ravi_fracture_2.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_fracture_2.text: The Fracture didn't just break the sky. It rewrote half the firmware in the city. Someone had to read it.

P_ravi_place_1.speaker: RAVI SHAH
P_ravi_place_1.text: Don't look at the lamppost camera. Don't look at any of them. They look back.
